posts.title: The 2002 and 2026 receipts from "Sunset Bay, Florida"
posts.claim: Two real receipts from the same store show the same six groceries going from $15.44 in April 2002 to $57.93 in October 2026.

store.place: 2847 Palm Grove Rd, Sunset Bay, FL 32987

notes: No town called Sunset Bay in Florida, no ZIP code 32987, no Walmart at the address and no store No. 4821.
Near-identical product codes run down both receipts 24 years apart, and none of them resolves to a product on Walmart's site.
TikTok applied its automatic "AI-generated media" label; Hive Moderation rated the image 99.9% likely AI-generated.

posts.title: "Found my mom's grocery receipt from 2006"
posts.claim: A 2006 Walmart receipt shows 79 items for $161.87. A reader who repriced 58 of its lines found them up 69%; other replies and reports put the cart at $350 to more than $400 today.
posts.basket_who: a reader on X (@reschultzed) who repriced 58 of the receipt's lines at a Walmart
notes: The full receipt is public on X and was read line by line by KTAL, USA Today and BuzzFeed. No outlet has traced the store, so the document is corroborated, not authenticated.
A reply quoted by UNILAD put eggs at "$4-$6" now; KTAL found a dozen at Walmart for $1.47.
